description: Model RagVectorDbConfig.ragManagedVertexVectorSearch in v1. Observed live 2026-10-30: a corpus created while RAG Engine is serverless is backed by RAG_MANAGED_VERTEX_VECTOR_SEARCH, but the v1 discovery document only has the field in v1beta1. Without it the response drops the backend, and a patch that echoes the corpus's vector config sends nothing, which the API reads as a change to RAG_MANAGED_DB ('The vector db type is immutable').

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Output only. The resource name of the Vector Search 2.0 Collection that RAG created for the corpus. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/collections/{collection_id}`
